purpose: Acceptance specifications, not observed model outcomes

cases.prompt: Assess recovery readiness from this supplied evidence; no optimization is requested.
fixture_requirements: Synthetic evidence: backup command and health check pass, but no end-user restoration or acknowledged-state integrity check was executed; no owner-approved RTO/RPO is supplied.
acceptance_criteria: Apply recovery guidance without requiring a latency optimization. Separate command success from actual restoration, preserve unknown timings and data loss, and do not invent targets or production verification.
